u0: Normal carrying phase: the box is in hand and no recovery is pending. Keep possession and navigate to the exit; if the box falls, switch to recovering it. Reaching the exit while still holding the box completes the task successfully.
u1: Recovery phase: the box has fallen and is not currently held. Locate and pick it up again; a successful pickup away from the exit resumes normal carrying and navigation. Do not finish by stepping onto the exit empty-handed: success requires reaching the exit only after regaining the box.
u2: Terminal success state: the exit has been reached with the box in hand. The task is complete and there is no further objective.
